purpose: Remove the Download links navigation entry, keep file-scoped direct/share/revoke actions, and make merge generation explicit after preview and save.
requirements: Remove the Download links navigation entry and its standalone panel entry point.
Keep direct-link creation, sharing, and revocation available from stored-file rows.
Hide row actions until the stored file is expanded, with keyboard-accessible disclosure.
Only a fresh preview may produce a merge result; edits or source changes invalidate the preview.
Prefer browser-local processing for future TypeScript/Python merge helpers and never expose SSH credentials to script code; arbitrary script execution remains deferred by ADR-0003.
constraints: Preserve existing authenticated APIs and direct-link/share semantics.
Do not execute user code in the Worker or add deployment secrets.
Keep the existing derived-object automatic refresh disabled for script-defined previews until an explicit product decision covers persistence.
Preserve the pre-existing unstaged BRANCHES.md pending-clear edit in the original checkout; continue recording later task operations in the ledger.
acceptance: The sidebar has no Download links control and the files view remains the path to direct links and shares.
Stored-file actions are hidden by default and expand/collapse without losing focus or state.
Direct link revoke and password share actions work from the file row.
A merge result cannot be generated from an edited or unpreviewed definition.
No arbitrary script execution is introduced; the existing configuration merge remains the safe path until a bounded browser-only design is separately approved.
evidence: Registry commit 373735f and worktree verified before implementation
UI 23/23; Workers 744/744 across 46 files; template and migration guards passed; Wrangler dry-run passed
next: Commit the reviewed implementation and registry updates; keep BRANCHES.md task records synchronized for later integration.
